tests.title: Web POS cash sale for a member creates a completed order and earns points
tests.goal: An in-store POS sale with Cash records a completed offline order on the member, with payment and loyalty points.
preconditions: Active store with Web POS (e.g. Storeberry HK) and a cash drawer selectable in POS Settings > Cash In Out
A QA member and a product in stock in the store warehouse
data: Store, product and member chosen at runtime; Cash is the only tender (user approval 2026-10-27)

steps.text: Physical Stores POS > Use (store) and select the cash drawer in Settings > Cash In Out
Add the product, select the QA member, click Total
Choose Cash, enter the exact amount, Submit, CHECK OUT
Note order number, points added and points balance on the Complete dialog, click Done
Open the order in the CRM and the member Point History

expected.text: Complete dialog shows an order number (TXN11...) with total, change 0 and points added
CRM order: Status Complete, Channel OFFLINE, Store and Warehouse of the POS, Payment History Cash with the paid amount, Delivery Status Complete
Point History has a Point Earned line for the order and the balance matches the Complete dialog

checks.label: Complete dialog shows an order number (TXN11...) with total, change 0 and points added
CRM order: Status Complete, Channel OFFLINE, Store and Warehouse of the POS, Payment History Cash with the paid amount, Delivery Status Complete
Point History has a Point Earned line for the order and the balance matches the Complete dialog

notes: TXN1126102700001, Storeberry HK / TEST12, Cash HKD 10, +1 point, balance 601 (incl. +100 Upgrade Reward).

tests.title: Refund a completed POS cash sale reverses payment and points and keeps fulfilment closed
tests.goal: A full refund of a POS sale creates a linked refund order, reverses earned points and does not reopen delivery.
preconditions: A completed QA POS cash sale (SCRM-085)
data: QA POS order created in the same session

steps.text: Open the POS order detail, Actions > Refund this order
Choose Original Payment Method, add a remark, Refund > Yes
Read Order Status, Payment Status, Delivery Status and the Refund order link
Open the refund order and the member Point History

expected.text: Order Status and Payment Status Refunded; a refund order <TXN>R exists with Cash -<amount>
Point History has Refund - Transaction removing the points earned by the order
Delivery Status stays Complete (the goods left the store at the sale)

checks.label: Order Status and Payment Status Refunded; a refund order <TXN>R exists with Cash -<amount>
Point History has Refund - Transaction removing the points earned by the order
Delivery Status stays Complete (the goods left the store at the sale)

notes: Refunded, refund order TXN1126102700001R Cash -10, -1 point. Delivery Status Complete -> Pending.

tests.title: Void a completed POS sale cancels it and keeps fulfilment closed
tests.goal: Voiding a completed POS sale cancels the order without reopening delivery.
preconditions: A completed QA POS cash sale
data: QA POS order created in the same session

steps.text: Open the POS order, Actions > Void this order > Yes
Read Order Status, Payment Status and Delivery Status

expected.text: Order Status and Payment Status Canceled

checks.label: Order Status and Payment Status Canceled

notes: TXN1126102700002 voided -> Canceled; Delivery Status Complete -> Pending.

tests.title: POS checkout tells the cashier when no cash drawer is selected
preconditions: Web POS open with no cash drawer selected (localStorage cashDrawerConfig empty)

steps.text: Add a product to the POS cart
Click Total

expected.text: A visible message asks to select a cash drawer (Settings > Cash In Out), or the payment screen opens

checks.label: A visible message asks to select a cash drawer (Settings > Cash In Out), or the payment screen opens

tests.title: Refund is not offered on an unpaid order
tests.goal: Money cannot be refunded on an order that was never paid, and the UI never accepts an action that it then ignores.
preconditions: A QA online order in Pending Payment (Bank Transfer, no receipt)
data: QA order created in the same session

steps.text: Open the order detail > Actions
If Refund this order is listed: Original Payment Method > Refund > Yes

expected.text: Refund this order is not listed (or disabled) for unpaid orders
If an action is refused, a message explains why

checks.label: Refund this order is not listed (or disabled) for unpaid orders
If an action is refused, a message explains why

notes: TXN0126102700006: Refund offered on Pending Payment; confirm does nothing, no message (twice).

tests.title: Cancel an eligible unpaid order and verify its history
tests.goal: Canceling an eligible QA order records a canceled state and audit entry.
preconditions: A dedicated staging QA order is unpaid and eligible for cancellation.
data: QA order selected dynamically; never select a real customer order.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM.
Open the eligible QA order and verify it is unpaid.
Cancel the QA order using the available cancellation flow.
Reopen its detail and status history.

expected.text: The order history records the cancellation and time.

checks.label: The order history records the cancellation and time.

notes: Unpaid guest order TXN0126102700006 voided -> Canceled; Status History "2026-10-27 12:22 by ghani Canceled"; stock released (VOID +1 Available).

tests.title: Refund a completed QA order and reconcile the refund amount
tests.goal: A refund on a completed QA order records the selected amount and refund state consistently.
preconditions: A dedicated staging QA order is completed and paid only through a documented sandbox payment method.
A sandbox refund operation is available.
data: Refund amount bounded by the QA order total.

steps.text: Sign in to the staging CRM.
Open the completed QA order and record its total.
Issue a refund for the full eligible amount using the sandbox flow.
Reopen the order and payment/refund history.

expected.text: The order displays the corresponding refunded/refund state.
The refund history shows the submitted amount and links to the QA order.
No live payment rail is used.

checks.label: The order displays the corresponding refunded/refund state.
The refund history shows the submitted amount and links to the QA order.
No live payment rail is used.

notes: POS cash order TXN1126102700001 refunded in full (Cash, no gateway); refund order TXN1126102700001R -10.00 linked both ways. Delivery Status side effect tracked in BUG-012.
Exploratory session 2026-10-27: POS sale, refund, void, unpaid refund/void.
